title: Create an empty file or update its timestamp
summary: Use the touch command to create a new empty file. If the file already exists, touch updates its last modified time to the current moment without changing its content.

steps.explain: Run touch with the path to the file you want to create. If the file does not exist, it will be created as an empty file. If it exists, its timestamp is updated.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file to create or update
